title: Netflix Celebrates 10 Years of Korean Stories in Seoul
summary:
Stars from “Squid Game” and “KPop Demon Hunters” took the stage in Seoul on October 24 as Netflix celebrated 10 years in Korea with a fan festival. The two-day event, called Netflix Janchi, ran October 24-25 at Sangam Oil Tank Culture Park. Thousands of fans enjoyed themed booths, games, merchandise, and live music.

“Squid Game” stars Lee Jung-jae, Lee Byung-hun, and Park Hae-soo were there, and Ahn Hyo-seop appeared for “KPop Demon Hunters.”

“Ten years ago, we dreamed big, but none of us could have imagined that Korean stories would move hearts around the world,” said Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos. He previewed two new shows: “Possible Love,” arriving November 6, and “Tantara,” following on December 11.

Netflix launched in Korea on January 6, 2016. Its first Korean series was “Kingdom,” in January 2019. Since June 2021, more than 200 Korean titles have made its Global Top 10. “Squid Game” Season 1 stayed on the chart for 32 straight weeks.
why_it_matters: It shows kids that stories from another country can become favorites all over the world.
